modules.name: Roles and Permissions
modules.description: Defines which of Raghuvir Admin, Society Manager, Resident, Assigned Person and Watchman may do each piece of work.

rules.title: Only Raghuvir Admin creates projects, buildings, flats
rules.description: Raghuvir Admin alone may create projects, buildings and flats. Society Manager, Resident, Assigned Person and Watchman may not.

rules.title: Only Raghuvir Admin creates or replaces Society Manager
rules.description: Creating or replacing a Society Manager is allowed only for Raghuvir Admin.

rules.title: Watchman creation and removal by Admin and Manager
rules.description: Raghuvir Admin and Society Manager may create or remove a Watchman. Residents, Assigned Persons and Watchmen may not.

rules.title: Resident add or approval by Society Manager
rules.description: Only the Society Manager may add or approve residents. Raghuvir Admin has view-only access.

rules.title: Only Residents self-register
rules.description: Self-registration is done by Residents only.

rules.title: Complaints raised for own flat only
rules.description: Society Manager and Resident may raise a complaint, only for their own flat. No other role may raise one.

rules.title: Genuineness check by Society Manager
rules.description: Only the Society Manager checks whether a complaint is genuine.

rules.title: Builder-responsibility complaints assigned by Admin
rules.description: Only Raghuvir Admin assigns a builder-responsibility complaint.

rules.title: Society-responsibility complaints assigned by Manager
rules.description: Only the Society Manager assigns a society-responsibility complaint.

rules.title: Who may mark a complaint Fixed
rules.description: The Society Manager may mark a complaint Fixed for society vendors. The Assigned Person may also mark it Fixed.

rules.title: Closure approval or reopen by complainant only
rules.description: Only the Resident who raised the complaint may approve its closure or reopen it.

rules.title: Announcement to all projects by Admin only
rules.description: Only Raghuvir Admin may send an announcement to all projects.

rules.title: Announcement to own project by Manager only
rules.description: Only the Society Manager may send an announcement to their own project.

rules.title: Contact directory permissions
rules.description: Raghuvir Admin manages the common directory and the Society Manager manages the directory for their own project. Residents can only view it.

rules.title: Society documents permissions
rules.description: Only the Society Manager manages society documents. Raghuvir Admin and Residents have view access.

rules.title: Hall or facility booking by Manager and Resident
rules.description: Society Manager and Resident may book a hall or facility. Other roles may not.

rules.title: Hall booking approval by Society Manager only
rules.description: Only the Society Manager may approve a hall booking.
